title: Andersen courtyard house — construction
summary: The courtyard house in Dripping Springs: limestone up, roof dried in, windows ordered.
updates:
2026-10-16|Limestone wall at full height|The west courtyard wall is up. The masons left the high window exactly where the evening light test put it.
2026-10-09|Roof dried in|Standing-seam panels start Monday. Rain barrels and cistern pad are set.
2026-10-02|Windows confirmed|Cypress windows confirmed for late November. I checked the shop drawings on site.
2026-09-25|Framing walk|We walked the framed rooms together and moved the studio door six inches. It matters; now is when it is cheap.
body:
The courtyard house in Dripping Springs: limestone up, roof dried in, windows ordered.

title: Okafor garden ADU — design
summary: The Hyde Park casita: design development, heritage oak protection, and the permit set.
updates:
2026-10-15|Permit drawings at 60%|The set is in the files. Please check the kitchen layout — two options, my recommendation is marked.
2026-10-05|Tree protection plan approved|The arborist signed off. The pier locations miss every critical root zone.
2026-09-28|First walk together|We paced the garden, found the oak's shade at 6 pm, and put the porch there.
body:
The Hyde Park casita: design development, heritage oak protection, and the permit set.
